title: The house
intro:
A bungalow on a quiet road above the harbour, five minutes' walk from the centre of Portree and the bus station. We opened in 2018 and live here ourselves.

There are five bedrooms, each with its own shower room, a guest kitchen where a complimentary breakfast is laid out every morning from seven, and a lounge with a television. Parking is on the drive, available on request: tell us when you book and we will keep a space for you.
